vo.l01: Tonight... it's lunch time in the ring. And only one of these two fighters is on the menu.
vo.l02: In the red corner... the burger! Two juicy patties, melted cheese, and a pickle nobody asked for. It drips sauce on every shirt it has ever touched.
vo.l03: And in the blue corner... the human! Ate an hour ago, already hungry again, and he never, ever says no to extra fries.
vo.l04: Fun fact: this burger has more layers than this guy's personality, and way more cheese.
vo.l05: Ohh! The burger smacks him with a big greasy right hand! That's gonna stain!
vo.l06: But humans have something burgers never had... a big mouth, sharp teeth, and no shame.
vo.l08: Down goes the burger! Sauce everywhere!
vo.l10: Your winner... the very hungry human!
vo.l11: The burger came here to fight, but it left as a meal. And the human? He's already asking for dessert... with a large shake.
vo.l12: Let's see that again... watch the uppercut. The top bun flies, the pickle goes everywhere. Delicious.

caption: Lunch fights back 🍔🥊 Who wins: the burger or the hungry human? 👇
